edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are a group of inherited neurodegenerative lysosomal storage disorders (LSDs), traditionally grouped together based on shared clinical symptoms.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: NCL mutations have far-ranging effects on cellular functions including autophagy and synaptic dysfunction.
